Source

pass1b-06/analysis/transcriptomics/transcript-rna-seq/normalized-data/*normalized-log-cpm*

Details

Filtering of lowly expressed genes and normalization were performed separately in each tissue. RSEM gene counts were used to remove lowly expressed genes, defined as having 0.5 or fewer counts per million in all but one sample. To generate normalized sample-level data, filtered gene counts were TMM-normalized using edgeR::calcNormFactors(), followed by conversion to log counts per million with edgeR::cpm().
